Class ProductManagementController

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.controller.ProductManagementController
public class ProductManagementController extends Object
Controller for managing product operations including viewing, adding, updating, removing products, and inventory management. Coordinates between the view and product service layer, and handles sample data initialization.

    • handleViewAllProducts

      public void handleViewAllProducts()
      Handles displaying all products in the inventory. Catches and handles any exceptions during the loading process.

    • handleViewByCategory

      public void handleViewByCategory()
      Handles viewing products filtered by category. Prompts the user to select a category and displays matching products.

    • handleViewBySubcategory

      Handles viewing products filtered by subcategory. Prompts the user to select a category first, then a subcategory.

    • handleSearchProducts

      public void handleSearchProducts()
      Handles searching for products by name. Prompts the user for a search term and displays matching products.

    • handleViewLowStock

      public void handleViewLowStock()
      Handles viewing products with low stock levels. Displays products that are below the low stock threshold.

    • handleViewExpired

      public void handleViewExpired()
      Handles viewing expired or soon-to-expire products. Displays products that have passed or are nearing their expiration dates.

    • handleAddProduct

      public void handleAddProduct()
      Handles adding a new product to the inventory. Prompts the user for all required product information.

    • handleUpdateProduct

      public void handleUpdateProduct()
      Handles updating an existing product's information. Displays all products first, then prompts for product ID and new information.

    • handleRemoveProduct

      public void handleRemoveProduct()
      Handles removing a product from the inventory. Displays all products first, then prompts for product ID and confirmation.

    • handleRestockProduct

      public void handleRestockProduct()
      Handles restocking a product by adding to its current quantity. Displays all products first, then prompts for product ID and quantity to add.
